facts.text: I'm only a farmer, but I'll see this baby safe to Tir Asleen. First, some bread for the road.
facts.why: Not in the film. Willow's real, well known line about the running joke is 'Don't call me a peck!'

vibe.verdict: Good Nelwyn fair look with the peck quote, wizard's test and tavern brawl stew, but the acorn and Bavmorda lines did not print.
missing: Madmartigan in the crow's cage (cue not printed)
ideas: Swap 'Tir Asleen fennel crackling pork' note for 'You're all pigs!' (Bavmorda's spell at Nockmaar)
Replace 'Brownies' berry and cream tartlets' with two tartlets named for Franjean and Rool
Swap 'Roast chestnuts with sea salt' note for the Peck line ('Don't call me a peck')
Replace 'Elderberry cordial' with a love dust potion
iconic: Madmartigan in the crow's cage at the crossroads (cue, house starter)
Raziel as possum, rook and goat (wink)
changed: Pork renamed Nockmaar fennel crackling pork, note is Bavmorda's real pig line
Stew renamed Tavern brawl beef and root veg stew
Acorn bites note tied to Willow's acorn threat
Winks: grass raft, love dust, Raziel's three forms replace basket, swordsman, possum
